headline: PIT @ HOU matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PIT 3.96 at HOU 4.74, with a projected total of 8.69. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward HOU: PIT moved +0.22 runs while HOU moved +1.68, changing the projected margin by -1.46 runs. The projected total climbed +1.90, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -27.2%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Bubba Chandler has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Spencer Horwitz, Taylor Trammell, Bryan Reynolds, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Braden Shewmake because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
